title: Input symbol at a specified position
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y$ be a binary input, let $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(6)$, let $x,u$ be binary words, and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\leq |y|$. For any integer head positions $a,b$, the loader configuration with physical input head at position $i+1$ reads the optional symbol $y[i]$ (which is absent when $i=|y|$).
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine and consider a loader configuration over a physical input $y$ whose input head is at position $i + 1$ with $i \le |y|$. The symbol read from the physical input is the optional bit of $y$ at index $i$, which is blank exactly at the right boundary.
